notes: Handles the iOS empty Wallet payload without failing the Shortcut. When amount is zero/missing and currency, merchant and name are all blank, Wallet Counter asks whether the tap was SL. Yes logs the existing SL fare/transfer logic at the original tap time; No changes nothing. Prompts expire after 24 hours, and out-of-order responses avoid double-counting. Partially populated malformed purchases still fail normally. No Shortcut changes.
